content:
Priya (ProdMktg): Kickoff — Pulse Lab experiment idea: offer webinar attendees 50 starter credits + an in-app prompt template pack. Goal = improve D7 activation for webinar leads. Need playbook: prereg email, first in-app nudge w/ recording + template, 2 follow-up nudges over 7 days, routing rules for high-engagers. Who's in?

Evan (Data): Love it. Can we set clear primary metric? I suggest D7 active (>=1 generation) + median tokens/day. I can pull baseline and power calc. Also suggest cohort tag = webinar_pulse_2026.

Aisha (Growth): Agree. Also propose A/B: 50 credits vs 100 credits. And factorial: promptpack vs no promptpack. Small cell sizes but worth it.

Tom - Content: I can draft the three nudge copy variants: onboarding quickstart, product demo prompts, and templates-for-use. Short, action-first. ETA Tue EOD.

Leif (DevEx): We can push prompt packs via internal API. Quick example payload for engineering: 
```
POST /api/v1/promptpacks
{
  "pack_id": "pulse-2026-1",
  "prompts": ["Starter demo", "Email subject gen", "UX copy"]
}
```
I'll own delivery + QA for the injection.

Marco (Growth Ops): Routing notes: if user consumes >500 tokens within 24h after receiving template => tag as high-engage and route to #cs-hand-off + create CSM task. Otherwise keep in nudge sequence. I'll wire with Zapier + webhook, but need the exact condition list.

Priya (ProdMktg): Timeline proposal: copy + templates Tue EOD, dev QA Wed, launch Thu 09:00 PT (coincides with webinar followups). Evan can you surface baseline numbers by EOD Monday?

Evan (Data): Yup. I'll return D0-D7 conversion, median tokens, and a suggested min detectable effect for 2-week run.

Aisha (Growth): Webinar recording link should be in first nudge. Second nudge = tips on using the promptpack (how-to). Third nudge = case use and CTA to create a demo. Also: measure retention on top 3 prompts.

Priya (ProdMktg): Assignments: Tom = copy, Leif = promptpack delivery, Marco = routing + Zapier, Evan = metrics. I can own A/B assignment flag and rollout.

Tom - Content: I'll drop drafts into Drive and ping here when ready. Short bullets + subject lines.

Leif (DevEx): One more thing — we should include a small 'how to use' modal in-product the first time the promptpack is injected. I can add that as opt-in.

Marco (Growth Ops): For handoff thresholds: propose 500 tokens OR 5 completions in 24h. Will implement as OR condition. Need confirmation.

Priya (ProdMktg): Confirmed. Use OR. Also decision: credits expire in 30 days. Mention in copy.

Tom - Content: Draft subject lines: 1) "Here's your 50 starter credits + prompt pack" 2) "Build a working demo in 5 mins — starter prompts inside" 3) "Try these templates + see results". Feedback welcome.

Evan (Data): FYI I'll add event names: webinar_register, webinar_attend, pulse_promptpack_injected, tokens_consumed_24h. That'll make cohorting easier.

Aisha (Growth): Let's also test CTA variants: 'Start with template' vs 'Claim credits' — could be subtle but worth.

Priya (ProdMktg): Final checklist before launch: copy in Drive (Tom), promptpack payload (Leif), Zapier webhook (Marco), metric dashboard (Evan), QA sign-off (Leif + Priya). Launch Thu 09:00 PT.

calendar-bot: Reminder — Webinar scheduled 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Recording link will be auto-posted to thread 15m after end.

Priya (ProdMktg): thanks everyone — will send a quick Loom summarizing actions. :party-parrot:
